independent_aggregate_statistics: Use existing Cloudflare zone HTTP analytics for unknown-location requests; requests and bots are not equivalent to human users or GA4 page views.
implementation_status: LOCAL RELEASE CANDIDATE; owner confirmed measurement basis; Google account checks incomplete; not published.
US_rule: Resolved through the trusted-region regulatory group; other US regions are unresolved, not automatically classified as consent-mandatory.
AU_rule: Reasonably necessary ordinary nonsensitive analytics; APP 3/5/6/8 collection notice, minimisation, purpose and overseas accountability must be verified. Not an advertising/sensitive-data exemption.
JP_rule: Unresolved under existing pending assessment, not asserted legally identical to EU.
privacy_signals: GPC and DNT stop analytics in every country
geolocation: First-party /_ma/region active; asynchronous lookup, 60000 ms maximum; /cdn-cgi/trace fallback; no HTML injection.
state_geolocation: Existing Cloudflare Worker prepares HTML metadata and /_ma/region from request.cf only, not client headers. Requires separate owner-approved Worker publication; a Pages deploy alone does not activate it. Trace fallback has no state.
advertising: All three advertising consent parameters remain denied independently
refusal_reprompt: In prior-consent/banner regions, show the banner on every new page load after rejection or closing. Rejection continues to stop GA4 until explicit acceptance. No prompt just on focus; GPC/DNT do not trigger reprompt. Acceptance persistence is unchanged.

automatic.description: Documented applicable basic-analytics basis; transport decided independently of storage permission.

prior_consent.description: Applicable consent requirement; GA4 with storage only after explicit acceptance.

unresolved.description: Owner-requested global denied-storage measurement proposal; not a verified legal exemption. Explicit refusal/privacy signals stop measurement. Known prior-consent rules still take precedence.

rules.basis: Existing device-access consent findings; no blanket cookieless exception.
Existing findings: no applicable ordinary-GA4 exception established.
Existing local draft basic-service/provider conditions; not a country-wide exemption for every analytics purpose.
Existing BR/ZA local findings and proposed basic-only legitimate-interest profile; common EU-controller/provider prepublication checklist remains required.

unresolved_measurement.limitations: HTTP requests are not unique people; no new client beacon or Google grant.

regional_policy.change_rule: New evidence changes jurisdiction-group/rule facts, not JavaScript country branches. No inferred law from continent, page language, missing geography or an unreviewed country.
regional_policy.no_banner_invariant: For a fresh visitor after regional resolution, an automatically hidden banner requires enabled GA4 measurement. Explicit refusal, GPC/DNT and technical blocking remain measurement-off exceptions.

global_measurement_proposal.basis_status: Owner confirmation recorded in conversation; not independent legal certification
